title: Sardinian Rocket Panzanella
description: A refreshing summer salad originating from Sardinia, Italy, featuring juicy tomatoes, tender bread, and peppery rocket.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine diced tomatoes, cubed bread, and chopped rocket.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
3. Pour the dressing over the tomato mixture and toss to combine.
4. Add diced panforte and toss gently.
5. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
6. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
7. Before serving, toss the salad gently and adjust the seasoning if needed.
8. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
